ai.description: Reusable engineering knowledge: principles, architecture, workflow, coding standards, debugging, testing, security, performance. Use for ALL development tasks.

project.description: Project-specific knowledge: overview, rules, UI, database, API, deployment, known issues. Use for THIS project's context.

web.description: Web frontend chat: index.html, css/style.css, js/chat.js. Side-by-side layout with chat and manual panel.

fix.description: Fix a bug. Provide the issue description after the command.
fix.template: Debug and fix this issue: $ARGUMENTS. Follow .antigravity/workflow.md. Reference .ai/core/debugging.md.

review.description: Review code changes for quality, security, and performance.
review.template: Review the current changes for quality, security, performance, and regressions. Use .ai/agents/reviewer.md checklist.

test.template: Run the test suite and report any failures. Check .ai/core/testing.md for testing strategy.

deploy.template: Run pre-deployment checks from .ai/skills/deployment.md, then deploy. Check .antigravity/deployment.md for project-specific steps.

migrate.template: Handle database migration: $ARGUMENTS. Check .antigravity/database.md for schema context.
